items.source_text: 从育成过程中曾在橡树大赛获胜的赛马娘身上继承心意，\n于橡树大赛、天皇赏（秋）取得胜利，\n并且粉丝数达到320000人以上
items.current_text: Kế thừa tâm ý từ một Mã Nương từng thắng Yushun Himba trong quá trình Huấn luyện,\nthắng Yushun Himba và Tenno Sho (Autumn),\nđồng thời đạt Số fan từ 320000 trở lên

community_terms.basis: Generic 赛马娘 is the project world/species term Mã Nương, but it must not fire inside established proper race names such as 府中赛马娘锦标 (Fuchu Uma Musume Stakes).

items.source_text: 取得阪神两岁雌马大赛的胜利，所有比赛都以干劲“绝好调”出战，\n在没有过“变胖”、“皮肤粗糙”、“懒惰成性”的情况下\n并且所有训练设施达到LV3以上完成育成
items.current_text: Thắng Hanshin Juvenile Fillies, tham gia mọi Cuộc đua với Mood “Great”,\nkhông từng bị “Slow Metabolism”, “Skin Outbreak” hoặc “Slacker”,\nvà hoàn tất Huấn luyện khi mọi cơ sở Huấn luyện đạt LV3 trở lên

community_terms.basis: Common player-facing Uma Musume state term; Mood/Mood Effect is the established terminology.
Named negative Condition; established Global name Slacker. Outside the Condition-name table, match only an explicitly quoted occurrence of the exact source alias.
Named negative Condition; established Global name Skin Outbreak. Outside the Condition-name table, match only an explicitly quoted occurrence of the exact source alias.
Named negative Condition; established Global name Slow Metabolism. Outside the Condition-name table, match only an explicitly quoted occurrence of the exact source alias.

The canonical player-facing Mood ladder already defines JP 絶好調 / zh-CN 绝好调 as Great (Race0634). Reuse the same fixed gameplay state in text_data requirements and descriptions; the full state token is specific enough to match without promoting generic 好调 prose.

source_bridge_terms.note: 干劲 is the zh-CN bridge for the player-facing Mood state. Do not normalize it to generic Vietnamese wording such as 'Tinh thần' or 'Hứng khởi'.
Named negative Condition; established Global name Slacker. Explicitly quoted source aliases are safe named-Condition references outside category 142; unquoted prose remains outside this rule.

items.source_text: 参加重赏比赛达到23次以上，\n并在人气第二以上的情况下取得菊花赏、天皇赏(春)的胜利；\n且粉丝数达到32万以上
items.current_text: Tham gia ít nhất 23 cuộc đua graded,\nthắng Kikuka Sho và Tenno Sho (Spring) khi có độ yêu thích hạng 2 trở lên,\nđồng thời đạt Số fan từ 320000 trở lên

community_terms.basis: In Uma Musume/Japanese racing, 重赏 denotes the graded-race category (G1/G2/G3), not a literal 'heavy reward'. Global/community player-facing English consistently calls these graded races. Keep the canonical alias as the modifier 'graded' so it composes naturally with the project's generic Cuộc đua label in longer Vietnamese strings.

Common EN-version Power stat label. The zh-CN alias 力量 is ambiguous in ordinary prose and can also occur inside proper names such as 莱茵力量 (Rhein Kraft); known non-stat compounds, names, descriptive titles, and narrative/metaphorical phrases are explicitly excluded so physical or emotional strength is not normalized to the stat label.

In Uma Musume/Japanese racing, 重赏 denotes the graded-race category (G1/G2/G3), not a literal 'heavy reward'. Global/community player-facing English consistently calls these graded races. Keep the canonical alias as the modifier 'graded' so it composes naturally with the project's generic Cuộc đua label in longer Vietnamese strings.
